title: Adapter Array
description: Chain joltage adapters and count distinct valid arrangements using dynamic programming.
writeup:
## Approach

Sort the adapters and add the outlet (0) and device (max+3). The chain must use every adapter with gaps of at most 3 jolts.

## Part 1

With all adapters sorted, compute consecutive differences. The answer is the count of 1-jolt gaps multiplied by the count of 3-jolt gaps.

## Part 2

Count distinct valid arrangements using dynamic programming. For each adapter, the number of ways to reach it is the sum of ways to reach the adapters 1, 2, or 3 jolts below it. The 3-jolt gaps act as mandatory bottlenecks that partition the chain into independent segments, keeping the total number of arrangements finite despite the exponential growth within each segment.
